regime_context: US S&P 500 detector shows AI Infrastructure as the rank leader (score 1.56) with US Energy Complex close behind (1.38), a narrow 0.19-point margin that is not a confirmed handoff. 45% of themes remain trend-gate eligible and the gate has historically helped on this market, so the discipline supports moderate trend-following, but rotation timing carries no validated edge and track_record direction accuracy (0.46) argues for low conviction overall.
emerging_watch: Watch whether US Energy Complex (XLE) closes the 0.19-point leadership margin over AI Infrastructure while both remain trend-gate eligible and energy breadth stays above 0.5 — a confirmed handoff would require energy to take rank 1 AND hold it for at least 10 sessions.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Leader with rank 1, eligible, not crowded (z 0.15), strong durability_bar (0.50) and a stable quiet val_state. While momentum is only a focus lens, the absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg) confirms the theme is still trending, so the lean is to remain long the existing leadership rather than rotate away — a staying-power direction, not a return forecast.
evidence: gate_helps=true (trend gate validated on this market)
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure already dominates attention (headline weight 0.25) and breadth is only 0.125; a narrow leadership that can roll over quickly if its single-megacap pillar stalls, and the rank itself has ~0 forward IC.

falsifier.text: SMH falls below its own 20-day absolute-trend gate and stays below for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Challenger rank 2 with notably stronger breadth (0.636 vs leader 0.125) and higher durability_bar (0.62), not crowded. Broad cohesion plus a still-positive trend-gate makes this the most plausible rotation beneficiary if the AI trade narrows further; the lean is modest because the handoff is not yet confirmed and rotation timing is display-only.
theses.dissent: The momentum margin is only 0.185 and momentum itself has weak or insignificant forward IC; energy can just as easily be the lagging sector in a re-acceleration of AI leadership rather than the next leader.

falsifier.text: XLE underperforms SMH by 5% over any rolling 20-trading-day window before the check-by date without reclaiming its absolute-trend gate.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Strong rank 3 with a genuine trend tag and high durability_bar (0.75), but it is the only crowded trending theme (crowding_z 1.61). Crowding is a size-down/caution flag rather than a fade signal, so rather than underweight, the appropriate stance is to avoid adding fresh exposure while it remains crowded — a cautious non-directional posture, not a short.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no validated basket-level forward edge and a genuinely trending theme can stay crowded for a long time without breaking down; avoidance here may simply miss continued participation in an intact trend.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z normalizes below 0.5 while its eligible trend-gate stays positive for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
